about:
Wire Wiz Electrician Services has operated from Egg Harbor Township, New Jersey since 1985. The company serves residential customers across the South Jersey shore region, including communities such as Atlantic City, Ocean City, Brigantine, and Galloway Township.

The firm provides a full range of residential electrical services, from lighting installation — recessed, kitchen, bathroom, basement, pendant, outdoor, and motion lighting — to electrical panel upgrades, meter socket replacement, service entrance cable replacement, and outlet repair. Additional offerings include knob-and-tube removal, ceiling fan and attic fan installation, bathroom exhaust fans, baseboard heating, programmable lighting control, digital thermostat installation, dimmer switches, and holiday lighting safety. The company also performs electrical home safety inspections.

Wire Wiz primarily serves homeowners in the coastal and inland towns of Atlantic and Cape May counties. Its service area spans Absecon, Atlantic City, Brigantine, Egg Harbor Township, Galloway Township, Linwood, Longport, Margate, Marmora, Mays Landing, Northfield, Ocean City, Pleasantville, Somers Point, and Ventnor.

The company highlights its 100% recommendation rating on HomeAdvisor, a Yelp recommendation, and seven Angie's List Super Service Awards earned since 2014. It emphasizes same-day and emergency response availability and advises customers against electricians who push service contracts, offering instead a monthly special discount service.
